payload.description: The Quality Engineer's first turn was not a raw JSON object -- it carried leading prose ('STATUS: in_progress ... Progress so far: ...') and wrapped the actual attempt_requested envelope inside a Markdown ```json code fence, followed by trailing prose. This violates quality-engineer.md's Output contract ('Exactly one raw JSON object per turn, no fence, no prose, response_type first'). Classified as a transport/parse failure, not a content failure -- the embedded JSON itself appears well-formed, but the turn as delivered does not parse as strict JSON.
